{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=July 2025}}
'''Avner Ash''' is a professor of mathematics at [[Boston College]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.bc.edu/bc-web/schools/morrissey/departments/math/people/faculty-directory/avner-ash.html |title=Faculty Page of Avner Ash |website=Boston College |access-date=18 September 2025}}</ref> Prior to that, he held faculty positions at [[Columbia University]] and [[Ohio State University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Avner Ash |url=https://www.helixcenter.org/participants/avner-ash/ |access-date=2026-08-26 |website=The Helix Center |language=en-US |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191023034203/https://www.helixcenter.org/participants/avner-ash/|archive-date=2019-10-23 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="genealogy">{{Cite web |title=Avner Ash - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=11332 |access-date=2026-08-26 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250915185228/https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=11332|archive-date=2025-09-15 |url-status=live}}</ref>

Ash received his Ph.D. from [[Harvard University]] in 1975 under the supervision of [[David Mumford]].<ref name="genealogy"/>

In 2012, Ash became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>

*{{cite book |title=ebook |year=2008 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7US0cSy70hoC|isbn=978-1-400-83777-9 |last1=Ash |first1=Avner |last2=Gross |first2=Robert |publisher=Princeton University Press}}
* {{cite book|first1=Avner |last1=Ash |first2=David |last2=Mumford |author-link2=David Mumford |first3=Michael |last3=Rapoport  |author-link3=Michael Rapoport |first4=Yung Sheng |last4=Tai |title=Smooth Compactifications of Locally Symmetric Varieties |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=PFSQdED_n2AC|year=2010 |publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0-521-73955-9}}
* {{cite book |first1=Avner |last1=Ash |first2=Robert |last2=Gross |title=Elliptic Tales: Curves, Counting, and Number Theory |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=42TlrlUv4QcC |year=2012 |publisher=Princeton University Press|isbn=978-1-400-84171-4}}<ref>{{cite web |last1=Berg |first1=Michael |date=March 16, 2012 |title=Review of ''Elliptic Tales: Curves, Counting, and Number Theory'' by Avner Ash and Robert Gross |website=MAA Reviews, Mathematical Association of America |url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/elliptic-tales-curves-counting-and-number-theory}}</ref>
